features.name: Java List mutability independent of nullability
features.scope: Invariant Java List signatures retain a MutableList..List bound when non-null, nullable or platform. Canonical ReadOnly and Mutable qualifiers select concrete Kotlin views independently. Explicit Kotlin read-only views retain their write restrictions; JVM signatures and inferred flexible metadata round-trip through both compilers.

features.name: Redundant read-only List projections
features.scope: List<out T> normalizes for source checking, source member indexing and Kotlin metadata decoding without changing its read-only contract. Type aliases, Java parameter compatibility and generic JVM signatures are tested. Mutable projections retain existing bounded metadata support and write restrictions.

features.name: Invocation-scoped Java generic variance safeguard
features.scope: Flexible expected types use the read-only upper bound. After ordinary overload selection, direct Java methods and constructors reject mutable/flexible generic widening as the pinned compiler does. Java field and synthetic-property assignments retain the pinned accepted behavior. Same-element mutable out projections and exactly-once argument evaluation are tested.

limitations: Only invariant Java List classifiers gain flexible mutability; raw and projected Java signatures, other collection families and broader projected Kotlin metadata remain at existing bounded support.
